# lol.trq.alts

> A consumer-agnostic account library for Minecraft: Java Edition, for launchers, tools, the host applications of bots, and account managers. Sign-in by Microsoft browser login (PKCE), device code, OAuth refresh token, cookie text, cookie file, session token, or offline, with silent renewal of a stored session; account management over a token (profile, entitlements, name, skin, cape, attributes, chat-signing certificate, blocklist) and anonymous profile lookup; paced bulk operations; an encrypted local store with an optional host-supplied key; per-account proxy routing; a shared vault with client-side encryption; and async avatar and game-stats caches. Pure JDK plus Gson, Java 25, with no Minecraft or renderer types of its own.

Current version: 0.12.0. Coordinate: `com.github.trq-lol:lol.trq.alts` on JitPack, with the release tag (`v0.12.0`) as the version. Gson is a compile-time API dependency that the host provides at runtime. The jar carries `Automatic-Module-Name: lol.trq.alts`.

The library is host-agnostic. A host supplies a few seams from `lol.trq.alts.spi` (session injection, storage directory, main-thread executor and notifications are required; texture upload, avatar source, stats source, proxy provider, store key provider, vault transport resolver and Microsoft auth config are optional) and wires one `AltsRuntime`. Building the runtime validates the required seams, binds the static stores, and loads them from disk, so `AltStore.accounts()` is populated as soon as it returns. The proxy provider, the executor, the stores and the store key are process-wide; a later null never removes one that is installed. Microsoft login takes the host's own Azure client id; the library ships no default, and `MicrosoftAuthConfig.legacyMsa` speaks the pre-Azure MSA dialect.

`AltLoginService` is the whole sign-in surface: seven routes (`loginMicrosoft`, `loginDeviceCode`, `loginRefreshToken`, `loginCookie`, `loginCookieFile`, `loginSession`, `loginOffline`) plus `loginAccount`, which reuses a stored session while it is live and otherwise renews it from the account's refresh token. Every outcome carries a typed `AltLoginCallback.FailureReason`: `NONE`, `UNKNOWN`, `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, `INVALID_TOKEN`, `NETWORK`, `NOT_CONFIGURED`, `NOT_ENTITLED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `XBOX_DENIED`, `DECLINED`, `TIMED_OUT`. A host branches on the reason, never on the message. A refused credential, an unreachable service and a rate limit are always classified apart. `LoginResult.xstsError()` carries the decoded Xbox Live refusal and `retryAfter()` the wait a rate limit stated. The device-code flow and the cookie chain were tested against loopback and scripted servers only, not against the live services.

`AltAccountService` (`check`, `refresh`) validates and renews a stored account without installing a session; `check` is read-only, and is the one to use when only looking, because the token endpoint rotates the refresh token on every redemption. `AccountStatus.State` is `VALID`, `RENEWED`, `EXPIRED`, `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, `NOT_ENTITLED` (which includes an Xbox Live refusal), `UNREACHABLE` (which includes a rate limit; `rateLimited()` tells it apart) or `UNKNOWN`.

`lol.trq.alts.account` is the surface over a live token, reached as `alts.accountServices(account)`: the full profile (and creating one for an entitled account that has none), entitlements as a product set, name availability, eligibility, change and a scheduled claim, skin and cape changes, player attributes and platform ban status, the chat-signing certificate, and the blocklist. None of it installs a session or touches the store. A read throws the checked `AccountException` carrying the HTTP status and any stated wait; a mutation whose refusal is an ordinary outcome returns a classified result. `alts.profileLookup()` resolves a player by name or UUID with no token, ten names per request for a list.

`lol.trq.alts.bulk` runs `checkAll`, `refreshAll`, `entitlementsAll` and `importCredentials` over many accounts with bounded concurrency, spacing between starts, a retry budget that only retries transient failures, per-entry progress, and cancellation. A rate limit, with or without a stated wait, stops the run by default or pauses it when the host opts out of stopping. Result labels are usernames or positional (`entry 4`) and never the input line.

Requests leave through `HttpUtil` and nowhere else: finite timeouts, a 1 MiB cap on JSON and text bodies, no redirect following except a bounded, credential-stripping one for images, and the host's `ProxyProvider`. Proxy resolution fails closed. An HTTPS target behind an HTTP proxy is tunnelled by the library, which sends the proxy credential on the `CONNECT` only and keeps connections apart per proxy identity; the JVM still resolves the target host name locally on that path. All blocking work runs on `IoExecutor.executor()` (a virtual thread per task, or the host's executor), never on the common pool.

The stores (`AltStore`, `SecretStore`) are AES-256-GCM files written atomically with a rolling backup. The default key is derived from machine properties and is obfuscation; a `StoreKeyProvider` supplies real key material. A file that cannot be read is never treated as empty: it is reported on `loadError()` and copied aside to `<name>.unreadable.<time>`. Under a provider the machine-derived key is accepted only on a launch that sets `migrateFromMachineKey(true)`, and while the key is unavailable every write is refused. A runtime built through the builder coalesces writes for 100 ms; `flush()` writes at once.

The shared vault implements the Alt Vault Protocol (AVP). It protects the accounts against a server that stores and relays faithfully, not against an actively malicious one; SECURITY.md states the gaps. `SharedVault` runs a `KeyBindingVerifier` before every key wrap and has no default verifier, and a host-persisted `RepoPin` rejects a rolled-back manifest. A refresh token is withheld from a repository unless its manifest opts in.

Notes for implementers: the library never imports a host type, and it must never name a specific consuming application, product, or sponsor, or another authentication library or tool, in source, docs, tests, or commits. DTOs are Java records with a `@SerializedName` on every component, and the ones that carry credentials override `toString` to redact them. Failure messages never repeat a transport exception's own text; use `FailureText`. Test seams are package-private and need `-Dlol.trq.alts.testSeams=true`, which the Gradle `test` task sets. House style is palantir-java-format (4-space, 120 column); run `./gradlew spotlessApply` before committing and `./gradlew check` to gate. Every multi-line Java snippet in the getting-started guide is inlined from a compiled example, so change the example first and the guide second.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/README.md): Overview, features, installation, and quick start.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Wiring the seams, every sign-in route, account management, lookup, bulk runs, proxies, the store key, and the shared vault.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Packages, threading, store persistence, transport rules, the error model, bulk runs, and vault verification.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/CLAUDE.md): The mental model, the patterns that matter, and the pitfalls, written for coding agents.
- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/examples/README.md): The compiled samples the guide inlines from.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history; the 0.12.0 section opens with upgrade notes.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability, and the threat model for the stores, the transport, tokens in logs, and the shared vault.

## Design records

- [Refresh-token design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/specs/2026-07-28-refresh-token-auth.md): Shipped. Why renewal, the sharing policy, and the typed failure reason are shaped the way they are.
- [Alt-management surface design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/specs/2026-08-05-alt-management-surface.md): Shipped across 0.8.0 to 0.12.0. Per-account proxies, operating on an account without logging into it, UUID-keyed avatars, entitlement as an outcome, bulk operations, and device-code login.
- [Account management and the 1.0 surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/specs/2026-08-06-account-management-1.0.md): The account services, shipped in 0.11.0 and 0.12.0, with a status note listing what remains before the 1.0 API freeze.

## Core source

- [AltsRuntime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/AltsRuntime.java): The wiring root and its builder; the one object a host constructs.
- [AltLoginService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginService.java): The sign-in interface every route lives on.
- [AltLoginServiceImpl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginServiceImpl.java): How each route resolves, renews, and classifies its outcome.
- [AltLoginCallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginCallback.java): `LoginResult` and the typed `FailureReason` a host branches on.
- [DeviceCodePrompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/spi/DeviceCodePrompt.java): The seam that shows a device-code challenge, and the phishing rule that comes with it.
- [MicrosoftAuthUtil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/MicrosoftAuthUtil.java): The Microsoft, Xbox Live and Minecraft chain: browser, device code, refresh, and the typed failure of each step.
- [MicrosoftAuthConfig](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/MicrosoftAuthConfig.java): Host-supplied client id, endpoints, and the OAuth vs legacy-MSA dialect.
- [CookieAuthUtil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/CookieAuthUtil.java): The cookie sign-in chain and the rules that bound where cookies are sent.
- [CookieFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/CookieFile.java): Reading an exported cookie file, byte-order-mark aware and size-capped.
- [XstsError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/XstsError.java): The Xbox XErr codes decoded, so a refusal says what to fix.
- [AltAccountService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltAccountService.java): Checking and renewing a stored account without logging into it.
- [AccountStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AccountStatus.java): What an account is worth right now, as a state a host can branch on.
- [AccountServices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/AccountServices.java): The surface over a token: profile, entitlements, name, skin, cape, attributes, certificates, blocklist.
- [ProfileService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/ProfileService.java): The profile read, the read that treats a missing profile as empty, and profile creation.
- [NameService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/NameService.java): Availability, eligibility, change, and the scheduled claim.
- [SkinService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/SkinService.java): Skin changes, with local validation before upload.
- [PlayerAttributes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/PlayerAttributes.java): Privileges, preferences and platform ban status.
- [CertificateService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/CertificateService.java): The chat-signing key pair.
- [ProfileLookupService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/ProfileLookupService.java): Anonymous lookup by name, UUID, or a list of names.
- [Entitlements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/Entitlements.java): What an account owns, as a product set and not a boolean.
- [AccountException](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/account/AccountException.java): The checked failure of an account call, with status, rate limit and stated wait.
- [BulkOperations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/bulk/BulkOperations.java): Checking, refreshing, reading entitlements of, and importing many accounts.
- [BulkOptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/bulk/BulkOptions.java): Concurrency, spacing, retry budget, and stopping on a rate limit.
- [CredentialKind](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/bulk/CredentialKind.java): What a pasted line is taken to be, and why it never guesses.
- [HttpUtil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/net/HttpUtil.java): The one way out of the library: timeouts, redirect rules, body cap, proxy routing.
- [ProxyTunnelSocketFactory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/net/ProxyTunnelSocketFactory.java): The CONNECT tunnel, and its documented DNS limit.
- [ProxyProvider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/spi/ProxyProvider.java): The per-request routing seam, and why it fails closed.
- [IoExecutor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/net/IoExecutor.java): The executor all blocking work runs on.
- [FailureText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/net/FailureText.java): Describing a failure by its kind, so a token never reaches a message.
- [AltStore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/store/AltStore.java): The account store, its mutators, and its load and save reporting.
- [StoreFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/store/StoreFile.java): The atomic writer behind both stores: backup, unreadable copies, key handling, migration, coalescing.
- [StoreKeyProvider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/spi/StoreKeyProvider.java): The host-supplied store key seam and its fail-closed rules.
- [AltAccount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/model/AltAccount.java): The stored account record, its copy methods, and its redacting `toString`.
- [AsyncCache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/cache/AsyncCache.java): The lazy, non-blocking, stale-while-revalidate, bounded cache.
- [AvatarSource](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/spi/AvatarSource.java): The face-fetch seam; the default crops from Mojang so no third party sees the account list.
- [SkinAvatarCache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/skin/SkinAvatarCache.java): UUID-keyed avatar cache with bounded downloads and retry on backoff.
- [TimeSource](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/time/TimeSource.java): The corrected-clock seam the scheduled claim reads.
- [SharedVault](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/vault/SharedVault.java): The transport-free crypto facade for a shared repository.
- [KeyBindingVerifier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/vault/transport/KeyBindingVerifier.java): The check run before every key wrap, and the explicit trust-the-transport choice.
- [RepoPin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/vault/RepoPin.java): The host-persisted rollback floor.

## Protocol

- [Alt Vault Protocol (AVP)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/avp/main/SPEC.md): The vendor-neutral wire standard this library's shared vault implements.
